svg.title: Algae Based Fuel Process
svg.desc: Original schematic illustration. Sun and Power Generation / Factory Emission feed cultivation in three Open Algae Ponds, with an Algae + Nonpotable Water detail. Cultivate leads to Harvest & Extract, then Refine. A fuel nozzle connects the Drop-In Replacement Fuel to Jet Fuel, Gasoline and Diesel, represented by an aircraft, a car and a truck. Equipment and organisms are illustrative, not measured.
svg.metadata: Original editable artwork composed from course source image_050.png, original ODP slide 50. No raster content. Source facts and route preserved; no commercial or environmental efficacy claim. Construction: shallow parallel projection, cylindrical sections and coherent upper-left lighting.
